item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Davey Hearn’s attorneys say Reflecting Pool charges should be dropped for good
item.description: Lawyers for former Olympic canoeist David Hearn asked a D.C. judge on Friday to bar the Department of Justice from ever again trying to charge their client with vandalizing the Reflecting Pool.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Measles cases skyrocket, and could keep climbing
item.description: On this episode of Catch Me Up, one of the foremost measles experts in the U.S. says an ongoing outbreak of the disease could get markedly worse as vaccination shortfalls become more apparent.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bok Tower Gardens record-breaking giant waterlily wins global competition
item.description: A Polk County botanical garden is celebrating a major victory after growing what it says is the world’s strongest waterlily pad.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pilot who died in Tampa Executive Airport crash flew without FAA medical clearance
item.description: A fiery crash Thursday morning near Tampa Executive Airport killed two people, including the pilot — Dr. David Siambanes — who records show was flying without a standard FAA medical certificate.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Renowned spine surgeon and nurse killed in Tampa plane crash
item.description: A surgeon and nurse in Tampa died on Thursday morning in a plane crash near Tampa Executive Airport.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Pasco deputy arrested: Former corporal faces child molestation charges
item.description: A Pasco County deputy was fired and arrested Friday on multiple charges, including unlawful sexual activity with a minor.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Is the beach public or private property? Hotel owner goes head-to-head with City of St. Pete Beach in lawsuit
item.description: The battle over a beach is now headed to federal court. St. Pete Beach is going head-to-head with a local hotel owner over the issue of who owns the sand.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Thousands of future Florida students could be impacted by new immigration rule
item.description: A student’s immigration status will now determine if they can attend a Florida public university. The Florida Board of Governors just passed on new rule for the next school year.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Gas prices set to break Labor Day record as diesel hits all-time high nationwide
item.description: AAA says gas prices are set to break the Labor Day record at $4.14 a gallon, while diesel hits an all-time high of $5.85.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Rays stadium plan, funding not expected to impact upcoming Bucs improvements
item.description: The Bucs are beginning plans for a major renovation of Raymond James Stadium, with the hope of improving the game day experience, and for one day attracting another Super Bowl.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa Family Dollar robbery: Police release video of armed suspect
item.description: Investigators are searching for an armed suspect who was involved in a robbery at a Family Dollar in Tampa.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa Bay Ferry gets $850,000 federal investment for dock in St. Pete
item.description: The Tampa Bay Ferry is one step closer to setting sail.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 'Just let me know what happened': Jabez Spann's mother continues to wait for answers 9 years later

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 'Emotions are high': Sarasota leaders urge peace after parking worker assault
item.description: A Sarasota parking enforcement employee was physically assaulted Wednesday afternoon while issuing citations on St. Armands Circle, leading to the felony arrest of a 61-year-old Bradenton woman.
